summary: Mayfair Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K containing unaudited condensed interim financial statements for the three months ended March 31, 2026. The filing covers routine quarterly financial results, including an operating loss of $7.3 million, cash of $32.3 million, and no disclosed special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or strategic review. This is a standard foreign private issuer periodic report under Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16, with no transactional or corporate-control implications.
